gripOrHq.title: Subliminal Corruption
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each advertisement you trash during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Frame-Up
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on both HQ and R&D this turn. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Give the Corp 1 additional Bad Publicity point if you liberated or trashed any Black Ops cards during those runs. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Live News Feed
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, the Corp gives you two tags, and you give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each black ice you encountered during the run, 1 for each Black Ops card the Corp rezzed during the run, and 1 for each Black Ops agenda you liberated during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Scaldan
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Scaldan counter. Each Scaldan counter forces the Corp to roll a die at the start of each of its turns. On a 5 or a 6, the Corp gains 1 Bad Publicity point. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Decoy Signal
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. Whenever you approach an unrezzed piece of ice during that run, expose it. You may jack out before the Corp decides whether to rez the ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Demolition Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, do not access cards; instead, trash all rezzed ice on the fort on which you just made a run, and the Corp gives you three tags.

heapOrArchives.title: Cruising for Netwatch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [1] and draw two cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Remote Detonator
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on a data fort this turn. Trash all rezzed ice on that fort, and the Corp gives you three tags.

heapOrArchives.title: Identity Donor
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Do not play Identity Donor as an action; instead, play it during the Corp's turn when you would suffer meat damage. Prevent that meat damage and give the Corp 2 Bad Publicity points. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Garbage In
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Vienna 22
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Viral Pipeline
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Crumble
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Crumble counter. Two or more Crumble counters allow you trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Garbage In
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Taxman
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Tax counter. Every two Tax counters cause the Corp to lose [1] at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Highlighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Streetware Distributor
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Take [1] from Streetware Distributor, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. A: Put [3] from the bank on Streetware Distributor.

heapOrArchives.title: Death from Above
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Trash, at no cost, all cards installed in a subsidiary data fort, even if they cannot normally be trashed. Use this ability only when you have just successfully made a run on that fort, and before accessing cards from that fort. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Airport Locker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [5], [T]: Search your stack for a program, and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. You may use this ability during an encounter with a piece of ice. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Score!
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [9].

heapOrArchives.title: R&D Mole
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Faked Hit
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Take 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Bolt-Hole
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Prevent 2 meat damage. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Senatorial Field Trip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if the Corp rezzed a piece of Black Ice this turn. The Corp either derezzes that piece of ice or receives 2 Bad Publicity points. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

scoreArea.title: Netwatch Operations Office
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Trace 2 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

scoreArea.title: Bioweapons Engineering
scoreArea.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Vienna 22
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Taxman
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Tax counter. Every two Tax counters cause the Corp to lose [1] at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Back Door to Netwatch
rig.rulesText: [3], [T]: Cancel the effect of a successful trace. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point if the trace would have had an effect other than or in addition to giving you any tags. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

rig.title: HQ Mole
rig.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from HQ. Use this ability only when accessing cards from HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Credit Subversion
rig.rulesText: [T]: The Corp loses [3]. Use this ability immediately after a successful run on HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Back Door to Rivals
rig.rulesText: [0]: Base link 2. [3]: +1 link. Gain [1] whenever you successfully use Back Door to Rivals to avoid a trace. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

ice.title: TKO 2.0
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] End the run, and Runner forgoes his or her next action.

ice.title: Canis Major
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +2 strength.

root.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
root.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Neural Blade
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

root.title: Trojan Horse
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

root.title: Efficiency Experts
root.rulesText: Gain 3.

root.title: Chance Observation
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

root.title: Setup!
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Fang
root.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 4 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].

root.title: Rex
root.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Vacant Soulkiller
root.rulesText: You may advance Vacant Soulkiller before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Vacant Soulkiller, it does 1 brain damage for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: Urban Renewal
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

root.title: Night Shift
root.rulesText: Gain [2] and draw one card.

root.title: Fatal Attractor
root.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Rockerboy Promotion
root.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

root.title: Chance Observation
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

root.title: Dedicated Response Team
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Dedicated Response Team, it does 3 meat damage. Ignore this effect unless Runner is tagged.

root.title: Hacker Tracker Central
root.rulesText: After each trace attempt, whether successful or not, put 1 from the bank on Hacker Tracker Central. During a trace attempt, each bit you spend from Hacker Tracker Central increases by 1 both your trace value and your trace limit.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Accounts Receivable
root.rulesText: Gain [9].

root.title: Cinderella
root.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 6 - If trace is successful, end the run, trash a piece of hardware, and do 2 meat damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

root.title: Urban Renewal
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

root.title: Trojan Horse
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

root.title: Night Shift
root.rulesText: Gain [2] and draw one card.

root.title: Corprunner's Shattered Remains
root.rulesText: You may advance Shattered Remains before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Shattered Remains, trash one piece of hardware for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Wall of Static
root.rulesText: [Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: D'Arc Knight
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.
